A restaurant website and digital menu your guests can use in seconds

Guests scan a code at the table or find you on their phone. We make sure what they see is current, fast, and easy to read.

Get a restaurant quoteTry the menu demo

What a restaurant package can include

Start with a digital menu, a full website, or both. Each piece is scoped to what your restaurant actually needs.

Restaurant website

Story, hours, menu, location, and contact on one fast, mobile-first site.

Digital menu

A menu page designed for phones, with clear prices and dietary notes.

QR code access

Printable codes for tables and windows that always open the latest menu.

Menu categories

Starters, mains, drinks, and specials organized so guests find things quickly.

Food photography layout

Space for your own dish photos, optimized so the menu still loads quickly.

Location and contact

Address, map link, phone, and hours that are easy to tap on a phone.

Reservations and ordering

Links to or embeds from the booking and ordering services you already use, where they allow it.

Menu management

Send us changes, or edit items and prices yourself if your package includes an editor.

Maintenance options

Seasonal menu updates, holiday hours, and site upkeep through a maintenance arrangement.

The guest's experience, step by step

  1. Scan the QR code

    A small code on the table or window opens the menu in the phone's browser. No app to install.

  2. Open the menu

    The page loads quickly even on a weak signal, showing your name and today's menu.

  3. Browse categories

    Guests jump between starters, mains, and drinks instead of scrolling one long list.

  4. View dishes

    Clear names, short descriptions, prices, and dietary tags, readable without zooming.

Your QR code does not change when the menu does

The printed code points to your menu page. Update prices or swap a dish, and every code in the restaurant shows the new version straight away.

Keeping the menu current

A menu that is out of date costs trust at the table. Choose the update style that suits your kitchen.

Send us the changes

Email or message the new items and prices; we update them under your maintenance arrangement.

Edit it yourself

If your package includes a menu editor, change items, prices, and availability from a simple form.

Plan seasonal menus

Prepare holiday or seasonal menus ahead of time and switch them on the day they start.

Read the digital menu implementation guide

Bring your menu online

Tell us about your restaurant and how often your menu changes. We will recommend a digital menu, a website, or both.
